visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid kente accent colors (brutalist, no soft shadows, tactical)
visual_enhancers.patterns: CSS-only diagonal stripes (repeating-linear-gradient) for empty states and disabled buttons

layouts.global: Mobile-first PWA. 'max-w-md mx-auto h-[100dvh] flex flex-col overflow-hidden bg-[#050505] relative'. Desktop views should look like a mobile device frame.
layouts.hud: Fixed top, h-16, solid #050505, z-50, border-b 1px border-kente-gold flex justify-between items-center px-4
layouts.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom, h-16, solid #050505, z-50, border-t border-gray-800 flex justify-around items-center w-full max-w-md

components.hustle_card: Flat surface #121212, p-4, border-l-4 border-kente-gold. Tap area takes up whole card. active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform.
components.progress_bar: h-2 w-full bg-gray-800 rounded-none mt-2. Fill color kente_green for clean cedis, kente_gold for dirty.
components.raid_banner: Sticky under HUD. bg-kente_red text-white text-xs font-bold py-1 px-4 flex justify-between animate-pulse uppercase tracking-widest
components.crew_card: Grid layout, border border-gray-800 bg-[#121212]. Avatar is a CSS abstract block with a bold initial letter.
components.heist_log: Terminal style. JetBrains Mono font. text-xs p-3 bg-black border border-gray-800 text-gray-400 with kente_green highlights for success.
components.welcome_back_modal: Bottom sheet modal (translate-y). bg-surface border-t-2 border-kente_gold. Massive kente_gold earning numbers.

motion.progress: linear width transitions for timers (transition-all duration-1000 linear)
motion.raid_alert: CSS keyframe pulse for background red/black to simulate heat
motion.modals: Slide up from bottom (translate-y-full to translate-y-0)

accessibility.contrast: APCA compliant. Gold/Red on Black provides extremely high contrast.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the raid pulse.

media.strategy: CSS-only. NO heavy images. Use @phosphor-icons/react for all icons (Duotone or Fill weights to match bold style).

universal_guidelines: Do not use transparent backgrounds for header/HUD or bottom nav. They must be solid #050505 to prevent scrolling content from showing underneath.
Add data-testid to ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='hustle-tap-btn', data-testid='nav-heists-btn').
Use mobile-first dimensions. Keep assets completely CSS-based (no image loads) for ultra-fast budget Android performance.
Use Twi/Pidgin slang in the UI text (e.g., 'Chale, police dey come!', 'Dirty Cedis').
Implement components in .js extensions instead of .tsx.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a high-performance CSS-only idle game targeting budget mobile devices. The HUD and Bottom Nav must be fixed and solid. Content scrolls in between. Use 'Anton' font for giant numbers/headers and 'Manrope' for body. Inject localized slang heavily. No images, rely strictly on colors, typography, borders, and CSS progress bars for the game feel.
